features.name: Simple return
features.definition: P_t/P_previous - 1
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Use comparable actual observations; corporate-action handling must be explicit.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Log return
features.definition: ln(P_t/P_previous)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Requires positive prices; do not mix adjusted research prices with raw execution prices.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Midpoint
features.definition: (best_bid + best_ask)/2
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: A reference value, not a guaranteed executable price.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Quoted spread
features.definition: best_ask - best_bid
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Use synchronized valid quotes; define treatment of locked or crossed states.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Spread in basis points
features.definition: 10000*(ask-bid)/midpoint
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Reject zero or invalid midpoint.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Depth within a price band
features.definition: sum(size_i) over eligible levels within a fixed distance from midpoint
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Record whether size is base units, contracts or quote notional.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Top-of-book imbalance
features.definition: (bid_size-ask_size)/(bid_size+ask_size)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Zero denominator is unavailable; cancellations can change it instantly.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Weighted midpoint proxy
features.definition: (ask_price*bid_size + bid_price*ask_size)/(bid_size+ask_size)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Often called a microprice proxy; not a universal efficient-price estimator.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Aggressor volume delta
features.definition: buyer_initiated_volume - seller_initiated_volume
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Validate venue side semantics; trade classification may be estimated.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Cumulative volume delta
features.definition: cumulative sum of aggressor delta from explicit anchor
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Resets, missing trades and side-classification errors change the result.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Order-flow imbalance
features.definition: For consecutive best-quote events n: e_n=I(b_n>=b_prev)*qb_n-I(b_n<=b_prev)*qb_prev-I(a_n<=a_prev)*qa_n+I(a_n>=a_prev)*qa_prev; OFI=sum(e_n) over the window
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: b/a are bid/ask prices and qb/qa their sizes; I is an indicator. Requires valid sequenced best quotes; not identical to trade delta.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Simple moving average
features.definition: sum(last n completed prices)/n
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Input price and warm-up must be specified.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Exponential moving average
features.definition: EMA_t = alpha*P_t + (1-alpha)*EMA_previous; alpha=2/(n+1)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Seed choice affects early values; require adequate historical warm-up.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Wilder moving average
features.definition: RMA_t = ((n-1)*RMA_previous + x_t)/n
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Common seed is the first n-observation SMA; choose and document exact convention.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: MACD
features.definition: EMA_fast - EMA_slow; signal=EMA_signal_length(MACD); histogram=MACD-signal
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Use one consistent EMA initialization and avoid future-bar updates.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: RSI
features.definition: 100-100/(1+RS), with RS=RMA(gain)/RMA(loss)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Both zero means a convention is needed, commonly neutral; loss=0 and gain>0 gives 100.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Stochastic percent K
features.definition: 100*(close-lowest_low_n)/(highest_high_n-lowest_low_n)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Zero range is unavailable or explicitly convention-handled; smoothing variants differ.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Rate of change
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: State whether output is a fraction or multiplied by 100.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: True range
features.definition: max(high-low, abs(high-prev_close), abs(low-prev_close))
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Session gaps and corporate actions affect comparisons.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Average true range
features.definition: Wilder moving average of true range over n periods
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: ATR is a range statistic in price units, not a probability-based confidence interval.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: ATR percent
features.definition: 100*ATR/close
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Use positive comparable prices; cross-asset comparison remains imperfect.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Realized variance
features.definition: sum(r_i^2) over an explicitly defined intraperiod sampling grid
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: This uncentered quadratic-variation proxy differs from sample return variance.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Sample return volatility
features.definition: sqrt(sum((r_i-mean(r))^2)/(n-1))
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Requires n>1; horizon, sampling and annualization must be stated.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Bollinger bands
features.definition: center=SMA_n; upper/lower=center +/- k*rolling_std_n
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Sample versus population standard deviation changes values; choose ddof explicitly.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Band width
features.definition: (upper-lower)/center
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Use a nonzero center; low width does not imply a known breakout direction.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Donchian channel
features.definition: max(high_(t-n:t-1)), min(low_(t-n:t-1))
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: For breakout signals exclude the current signal bar.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Directional movement and ADX
features.definition: up=high_t-high_prev; down=low_prev-low_t; DM_plus=up if up>down and up>0 else 0; DM_minus=down if down>up and down>0 else 0; DI_plus=100*RMA(DM_plus)/ATR; DI_minus=100*RMA(DM_minus)/ATR; DX=100*abs(DI_plus-DI_minus)/(DI_plus+DI_minus); ADX=RMA(DX)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Handle zero denominators and enough warm-up; ADX is strength, not direction.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Trade-based VWAP
features.definition: sum(trade_price*trade_size)/sum(trade_size) from an explicit anchor
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Specify eligible trades and volume units; zero volume means unavailable.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Bar-based VWAP approximation
features.definition: sum(((high+low+close)/3)*bar_volume)/sum(bar_volume)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: This is an approximation to trade VWAP; do not silently substitute it.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Anchored VWAP
features.definition: VWAP computed only from events at or after an explicitly chosen known anchor
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: A retrospectively chosen optimal anchor creates selection bias.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Relative volume
features.definition: current elapsed-session volume / historical mean volume at the same elapsed-session point
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Use preceding sessions only and comparable calendars; partial-day comparisons matter.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: On-balance volume
features.definition: OBV_prev + volume*sign(close-close_prev)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: A cumulative price-direction proxy, not observed buying minus selling.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Chaikin money flow
features.definition: sum(((2*close-high-low)/(high-low))*volume)/sum(volume)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Define handling of zero-range bars; it approximates flow from bar location.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Money flow index
features.definition: 100-100/(1+positive_money_flow/negative_money_flow); money_flow=typical_price*volume, classified by typical-price change
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Handle unchanged prices and zero-flow cases explicitly; it is a constructed oscillator.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Commodity channel index
features.definition: (typical_price - SMA(typical_price))/(0.015*mean_absolute_deviation)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: The mean absolute deviation convention must be consistent; zero denominator is undefined.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Rolling z score
features.definition: (x_t-training_or_lagged_mean)/training_or_lagged_std
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Specify whether current observation enters estimates; causal does not imply normally distributed.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Regression beta
features.definition: cov(asset_return, benchmark_return)/var(benchmark_return)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Training-only estimates; zero benchmark variance blocks calculation.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Log-price pair residual
features.definition: ln(P_A)-alpha-beta*ln(P_B)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Beta is an elasticity; convert approximate hedge into dollar notionals, not equal share counts.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Correlation
features.definition: cov(x,y)/(std(x)*std(y))
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: High correlation does not prove stationary spread or causality.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Drawdown
features.definition: 1 - equity_t/max(equity_up_to_t)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: State cash-flow adjustment and mark-to-market convention.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Gross exposure
features.definition: sum(abs(position_notional_i))/equity
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Nonlinear derivatives require additional Greeks and stress exposures; zero equity is invalid.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Net exposure
features.definition: sum(signed_position_notional_i)/equity
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Low net exposure can coexist with high gross and basis risk.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Basis fraction
features.definition: derivative_price/spot_reference-1
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Synchronize prices, units, currencies and timestamps; annualization applies only with a defined horizon.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Linear-contract funding cash flow
features.definition: cashflow_long = -signed_long_notional * funding_rate_at_event, under the specified venue convention
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: For a positive long notional and positive rate this is a payment; inverse/other contracts need exact specifications.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Open interest change
features.definition: OI_t - OI_previous, optionally normalized by a lagged level
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Open interest is not traded volume and does not reveal whether new positions are bullish.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Event surprise
features.definition: (first_release_actual - pre_release_consensus)/training_scale
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Consensus and release values must be vintage-correct and available at decision time.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Net trade expectancy
features.definition: p*mean_gross_win - (1-p)*mean_gross_loss - average_cost
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: For variable sizing or costs use full realized outcomes; do not subtract costs twice.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Profit factor
features.definition: sum(positive_net_trade_PnL)/abs(sum(negative_net_trade_PnL))
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: If no losses occur report undefined/infinite with sample context, never silently zero.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Sharpe ratio
features.definition: mean(period_excess_returns)/std(period_excess_returns)
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: Return frequency and autocorrelation treatment determine whether annualization is justified.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Implementation shortfall
features.definition: side_sign*(sum(q_i*(fill_i-decision_price)) + unfilled_qty*(terminal_price-decision_price)) + explicit_costs
features.timing_rule: Only observations and fitted parameters available by decision time may be used.
features.pitfall: For a buy side_sign=+1 and a sell=-1; benchmark and terminal time must be fixed. Positive values are execution cost.
features.definition_status: Mathematical convention supplied for implementation; not an empirical profit claim.

features.name: Token age
features.definition: decision_time minus verified successful creation time, with a separate first-observed age when creation time is unavailable
features.pitfall: First indexing time is not creation time; missing timestamps remain unknown.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Pool age
features.definition: decision_time minus verified pool activation time
features.pitfall: A migrated token can be old while its destination pool is new.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Chain observation lag
features.definition: received_at minus source block time where block time is known; also preserve slot distance from the observed head
features.pitfall: Block timestamps can be coarse, missing, or inconsistent across providers.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Quote freshness
features.definition: decision_time minus quote_received_at, plus source-state age and cross-route state dispersion
features.pitfall: A newly received quote may rely on old pool state.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: All-in round-trip cost
features.definition: entry impact plus exit impact plus all explicit fees, taxes, financing, expected failed-attempt cost, and currency conversion, expressed against consistent notional
features.pitfall: Do not double-count fees already embedded in executable outputs; uncertainty needs separate stress scenarios.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Fee burden by layer
features.definition: itemized protocol, LP, creator, transfer, hook, routing, chain, tip, and funding charges with currency and inclusion flags
features.pitfall: A single displayed swap fee is not necessarily the complete cost.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Executable exit proceeds
features.definition: net quoted output for the entire intended inventory at current state, with minimum output and additional external charges shown separately
features.pitfall: A quote or simulation is conditional and may cease to exist before execution.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Immediate round-trip retention
features.definition: net output from buying then selling a specified size divided by initial quote input under an explicitly defined state-update simulation
features.pitfall: Use post-buy state for the hypothetical sale; pre-buy sell quotes can be inconsistent.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Fixed-price reserve value
features.definition: sum of reserve quantities multiplied by frozen reference prices, excluding virtual balances
features.pitfall: TVL marked at the moving token price can rise without new capital.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: External liquidity addition
features.definition: net assets contributed through verified liquidity-add/remove events, valued at fixed reference prices
features.pitfall: Swaps, rebases, donations, and internal migration transfers are not automatically new outside liquidity.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Virtual reserve share
features.definition: virtual pricing reserve divided by effective pricing reserve where that protocol defines the quantities
features.pitfall: Virtual reserves influence quotes but are not freely withdrawable cash.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Curve progress
features.definition: protocol-specific completed funding or remaining-sale-state measure divided by the current verified target
features.pitfall: No universal graduation formula; use the correct program version and configuration.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Migration availability delay
features.definition: first verified usable destination-pool time minus confirmed curve-completion time
features.pitfall: An announcement, completion flag, and executable pool are different events.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Independent buyer estimate
features.definition: number of buying address clusters after versioned heuristic merging and exclusion of known services
features.pitfall: Clusters are estimates, not verified people; report raw address count alongside them.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Net buyer breadth
features.definition: count of eligible clusters with positive net acquired token quantity minus those with negative net quantity during a window
features.pitfall: Transfers, minting, airdrops, and liquidity operations must not be mislabeled as purchases.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Top-holder economic share
features.definition: sum of top-k eligible entity balances divided by explicitly defined economic float
features.pitfall: Pool vaults, bridges, custodians, burns, and vesting change denominator semantics.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Holder HHI
features.definition: sum of squared ownership fractions over the defined eligible holder universe
features.pitfall: Changing exclusions or unknown custody ownership can dominate the number.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Effective holder count
features.definition: 1 divided by holder HHI when shares are valid and sum to one
features.pitfall: Not a count of humans and not meaningful if the underlying shares are incomplete.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Unattributed supply share
features.definition: supply with unresolved economic ownership divided by the declared supply denominator
features.pitfall: A low measured concentration is weak evidence when much of supply is unattributed.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Funding-source entropy
features.definition: negative sum of p_j times log(p_j) over defined buyer-funding-source shares
features.pitfall: Exchange hot wallets create shared funding without proving common beneficial ownership.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: New-buyer retention
features.definition: fraction of a fixed past buyer cohort retaining at least the preregistered net purchased inventory at a later observable cutoff
features.pitfall: The later cutoff must already have occurred before the feature is used.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Returning-buyer ratio
features.definition: eligible current buying clusters that bought in a specified prior window divided by eligible current buying clusters
features.pitfall: Address recycling and common custody can inflate or suppress recurrence.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Creator-cluster net sales
features.definition: net verified token sales by the creator-linked cluster over the window, with linkage uncertainty retained
features.pitfall: Creator inventory can be hidden; a transfer away from the creator is not proof of a sale.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Dormant-supply activation
features.definition: token quantity moved by holders inactive for at least the registered period divided by defined float
features.pitfall: A move may be custody maintenance rather than intent to sell.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Labeled exchange net flow
features.definition: verified deposits to exchange-controlled addresses minus withdrawals during the window
features.pitfall: Label coverage, internal reshuffling, bridges, and timestamp lag require explicit handling.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Distribution-cohort sale ratio
features.definition: verified recipient sales divided by received distribution quantity for a fixed event cohort
features.pitfall: Receipt and sale attribution must be point-in-time and account for subsequent transfers.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Net external quote demand
features.definition: quote currency paid into economic token purchases minus quote currency received from sales, after specified internal-flow exclusions
features.pitfall: A router can generate multiple pool legs for one economic purchase.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.

features.name: Net-demand acceleration
features.definition: difference between comparable net-demand rates in consecutive completed windows
features.pitfall: Normalize units and duration; sampling gaps are not zero flow.
features.timing_rule: Use only versioned observations available by decision time; preserve block/slot, commitment, receipt time, and label availability.
features.definition_status: Author-supplied operational convention requiring data-specific validation; not a profitable signal claim.
